customer_need: Prevent an agent in a competition dialogue or delegated workflow from crossing an explicit action boundary without an auditable decision and authorization reference.

recommendation.reason: The experimental reference implementation has deterministic runtime tests, MCP protocol exchanges, canonical agent-evidence verification, replay and mutation defenses, a bounded real-GitHub sandbox trace, and one official native AgentTeams v1.2.0 local smoke. Product use remains not recommended because the native run was operator-supervised, did not enforce per-Worker tool ACLs or prove repository Skill materialization, used a preview model, retained semantic contamination and role-boundary deviations, and no production key management or independent security and operational review exists.

non_recommendation_reasons.reason: The MCP server and Action Gate exist as a local experimental reference, but there is no hardened authenticated network deployment or production key management.
non_recommendation_reasons.required_fix: Replace demo HMAC material, define key rotation and recovery, harden transport authentication, and independently review the deployed boundary.

non_recommendation_reasons.reason: The threat suite covers core prompt-injection, confused-deputy, expiry, replay and mutation cases, but it is not an independent penetration test or operational exercise.
non_recommendation_reasons.required_fix: Perform independent adversarial review, provider-credential compromise exercises, recovery tests, and multi-tenant isolation tests.

non_recommendation_reasons.reason: Native local Manager/Worker smoke evidence exists, but it did not establish autonomous end-to-end orchestration, enforced per-Worker MCP tool ACLs, repository Skill materialization, a stable model contract, persistent deployment, or operational readiness.
non_recommendation_reasons.required_fix: Enforce registry-scoped MCP ACLs, package and attest Skills, qualify a stable model, and retain a clean unassisted correlation-scoped native trace in an isolated reproducible environment.
